_doc: M1 / M2 parity cases. Every case starts from examples/hwr010/InputFile (beam.txt, input.txt), applies the key edits, writes lattice.txt verbatim and runs the engine with field maps read from examples/hwr010/InputFile. 'common_input' is applied to every case.

cases.name: SP2_rf_static_single
cases.compat_expected_diff: phi_s is NaN in AVAS.dll: candidate index -1 read out of range (undefined behaviour; the dst variant stops with "Scan phase error")

cases.name: SP3_rf_drift_dst
cases.compat_expected_diff: phi_s is NaN in AVAS.dll: candidate index -1 read out of range (undefined behaviour; the single-particle variant stops with "Scan phase error")

cases.name: RFQ1_minimal
cases.compat_expected_diff: AVAS.dll crashes (access violation) on the rfq element; the new engine reports "not implemented"

cases.name: D_PB_PB
cases.libm_sensitive: PB2D: one particle (U = 1 edge) takes another atan2/pow branch with a non-Windows libm

cases.name: D_PB_KV
cases.libm_sensitive: PB2D: one particle (U = 1 edge) takes another atan2/pow branch with a non-Windows libm

cases.name: D_probe
cases.libm_sensitive: probe grid: the centroids are sums of +-sigma that cancel to ~1e-20, so last-bit sigma differences change them completely

cases.name: D_probe_n100
cases.compat_expected_diff: AVAS.dll reads past the 100 generated rows (probe needs 125): undefined behaviour

cases.name: ER12_beam_stat_dst
cases.windows_process_end: AVAS.dll reads through a null pointer: a static beam error alone leaves the dynamic beam row out of the sample (access violation)

cases.name: ER20_r_minus1_single
cases.compat_expected_diff: r = -1: AVAS.dll keeps the previous value, which is an uninitialised stack value for the first draw (9.88131e-324 here)

cases.name: LB3_boundary_crlf_end_single
cases.compat_note: CRLF: end\r is an unknown shape in AVAS.dll

cases.name: SB1_secondary_text
cases.compat_note: first SeSynParticle line: the synchronous particle's field before the first step is uninitialised memory in AVAS.dll

cases.name: SB2_secondary_dst
cases.compat_note: 8 of 5260 particles differ in the 15th decimal after the quadrupole (SeHardEdgeTrans); the operation order matches the disassembly, the cause is not found

cases.name: EX_A22_no_end
cases.windows_process_end: AVAS.dll reads through a null pointer at the start of the phase scan (access violation)

cases.name: EX_A27_steerer_7_words
cases.windows_process_end: the stoi exception of the 7-word steerer leaves AVAS.dll uncaught (C++ exception 0xe06d7363)

cases.name: EX_A47_boundary_sp_out
cases.windows_process_end: the superposeout line that ends the boundary superpose block goes to stoi: the exception leaves AVAS.dll (C++ exception 0xe06d7363)

cases.name: EX_A47b_boundary_sp_shape_end
cases.windows_process_end: a boundary superpose block ended by a shape line also ends AVAS.dll with the stoi exception (C++ exception 0xe06d7363), before any output

cases.name: SI_B20s_static_reverse
cases.comment: static decelerating field (the hwr010 RF map read as a static electric map) reflects the synchronous particle; AVAS.dll checks reverse motion only in RF cavities, so the synchronous pass never ends (rc timeout in both AVAS.dll and compat; the default mode stops with the reverse-motion error)
